documents.title: Traffic Sign Detection
documents.description: Connecting a YOLO11 Nano detection model to an interface for image, video, and webcam inference.
documents.content: The public repository contains Python training and augmentation tooling, model evaluation materials, and a Gradio inference application. The interface accepts images, video, and webcam input. This is a research prototype. Benchmark numbers, performance improvements, and suitability for road use have not been independently verified for this case study. A production deployment would need representative evaluation, model and dependency checks, monitoring, and a separate safety assessment.

documents.title: Customer relationship management
documents.description: Exploring customer, sales, and support workflows through a collection of connected interface screens.
documents.content: The reviewed repository contains HTML interface files, including contact, sales, marketing, support, and ticket-detail views. It is a frontend prototype. The README identifies backend integration as future work. The public code does not establish a working FastAPI or PostgreSQL backend, server-side authentication, persistent customer records, or a deployed client CRM. Login and registration screens alone do not provide authentication.

documents.title: Manufacturing management
documents.description: An interface prototype for exploring products, orders, and manufacturing operations in one place.
documents.content: The public repository includes HTML, CSS, and JavaScript interfaces for a dashboard, products, and orders, plus a PHP processing file and architecture documentation. The available artifacts demonstrate the interface direction; they do not establish a complete production system. Production authentication, backend behavior, deployment readiness, and an end-to-end database system have not been verified. RAG and AI assistant capabilities described in planning material are future work. No operational efficiency gains are claimed.
